proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's transform effect applies to the Folding Boat itself, not to a creature-facing self/target/area attachment.

proposed_widenings.name: resource_free_activation
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has repeatable command-word activations with no charges, uses, or reset cadence, which the current activation surface cannot express honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use"

proposed_widenings.name: activation_precondition
proposed_widenings.justification: One command word is conditionally available only when no creatures are aboard, but activation phases have no branch-level precondition slot.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard."

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.form_zero_hp
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is destroyed when either transformed vessel reaches 0 HP, which is a different lifecycle trigger from the existing charge-depletion destruction policies.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "If either vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Folding Boat is destroyed."
